description: This source file defines a utility function for creating wake word segments from a transcript and a list of words with timestamps, used likely for testing in an OpenClaw-related project.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: A data structure used to represent a segment of a wake word within a transcript, including its text, timing, and range.

methods.name: makeWakeWordSegments
methods.description: Generates an array of WakeWordSegment objects by matching each word in the provided list to its occurrence within the transcript and calculating the corresponding range.
